site.domainNote: self-hosted static RSS/Atom feed aggregator (Bubo Reader)

view.name: Feed list (collapsed)
view.description: The reader's single page: feeds grouped under headings, each a collapsed disclosure showing feed title and URL, with errors and footer at the bottom.

regions.label: Owl emoji plus 'Bubo Reader' h1 title
Five categorized groups (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects) of collapsible per-feed disclosures showing feed name + gray feed URL
'Errors' heading with a bulleted list of feeds that failed to fetch/parse
hr separator, last-updated timestamp, powered-by credit links and sponsor link

evidence.note: Native <details>/<summary> disclosures with triangle markers; clicking a header reveals that feed's dated item links in place

patterns.rationale: It is an RSS reader whose content is chronological headline items from subscribed sources, but items are grouped per source inside collapsed disclosures rather than one continuous merged stream.

evidence.note: Subscribed feeds; expanding one shows date-ordered headline links (e.g. '11/7/2026 - Release Notes for Safari Technology Preview 232')

evidence.quote: There were errors trying to parse these feeds:
evidence.note: Plain unstyled section at page bottom, not a banner-style alert
Only one disclosure level under static h2 headings; better coded as accordion

structure.layout: single-column unstyled static HTML page: h1 title, h2 category sections each holding a stack of <details> disclosures (one per feed) that expand to dated link lists, an errors section, and an hr-separated footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (browser defaults): bold headings, regular body; links in default browser blue underline
aesthetics.typeScale: h1 36px bold, h2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular; hierarchy purely from browser-default heading sizes

notes: Essentially unstyled HTML: browser-default <details> triangles, default link blue #0000ee, gray (#aaaaaa) feed URLs after each feed title, an owl emoji as the only graphic, an <hr> before the footer. All feed items collapsed by default; expanded panels list 'M/D/YYYY - Title' links newest first. Errors from failed feed fetches are shown verbatim as raw error strings. Footer shows build timestamp ('Last updated ...') revealing it's a statically generated page.
